canonical_project: Guam Government Tier IV Data Center / World-class IXP (site TBD)
owner: Government of Guam (Office of the Governor)
notes: Guam Five-Year Action Plan (announced by Office of the Governor, Aug 2023) proposes a 'green, Tier IV data center that will serve as a world-class IXP'; site not yet selected; criteria include high elevation near ocean, multiple power grid access points, land for a 5-10 MW solar farm and tech park, >$60M potential investment (DCD B; official plan PDF A). No update found by 2026-08-12; status announced.
